summary: Day and dusk/night views from the 2018 SMU game, both from the east lower bowl.

files.author: Michael Barera

files.note: Elevated lower-bowl corner view across to the west stands and press box tower, pregame warmups at the Sept 2018 SMU game; field rows ~800-1520 of 1600 (50-95%), stands and press box ~0-50%, small sky patch top right; a few spectators along the bottom edge
